title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2141 Ferry Street in Anderson, California, as the "Norma Comnick Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2141 Ferry Street in Anderson, California, as the Norma Comnick Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Congress named a post office building in Anderson, California, after Norma Comnick.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2141 Ferry Street in Anderson, California, as the Norma Comnick Post Office Building. It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, rules, or funding.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 19, 2022, and the renaming took effect on that date.
